categories.main_business_segments: Yasuda Logistics Corporation operates two main business segments: logistics and real estate. The logistics segment encompasses warehousing, cargo handling, domestic and international transportation, and logistics facility leasing. The real estate segment focuses on the leasing and management of office buildings and related facilities, primarily in the Tokyo and Yokohama areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced logistics management systems, digital transformation (DX), and IT-based solutions to optimize warehousing, transportation, and supply chain operations. It employs both traditional and modern warehousing techniques, including temperature-controlled storage for pharmaceuticals and specialized handling for medical logistics. Facility management and building maintenance in the real estate segment utilize best practices in property management and redevelopment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yasuda Logistics serves a diverse range of customers, including manufacturers, trading companies, pharmaceutical firms, and retailers requiring domestic and international logistics solutions. The real estate business targets corporate tenants, especially in metropolitan business districts. Key end markets include the automotive, medical, consumer goods, and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary operations are in Japan, with a strong presence in the Tokyo metropolitan area and major regional cities. Internationally, it operates through subsidiaries and affiliates in China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore, and India, providing cross-border logistics and warehousing services.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yasuda Logistics operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated logistics, warehousing, and distribution services, as well as last-mile delivery and value-added logistics solutions. In real estate, it acts as a property owner and manager.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the logistics network domestically and internationally, enhancing high-value-added logistics services, and promoting operational efficiency through digital transformation and advanced technologies. The company emphasizes sustainability, diversity, and governance, with a focus on reducing CO2 emissions and strengthening group collaboration. R&D activities are limited, with innovation primarily driven by digitalization and process improvement rather than basic research.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees for warehousing, cargo handling, domestic and international transportation, and logistics facility leasing. The real estate segment earns income from property leasing and management fees. Additional revenue streams include value-added logistics services and facility redevelopment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese logistics and warehouse companies such as Mitsui-Soko, Sumitomo Warehouse, and Nippon Express, as well as regional and international logistics providers. Yasuda Logistics positions itself as a comprehensive logistics and real estate solutions provider with a strong reputation for reliability and high-quality service, leveraging its long history and extensive domestic and international network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated operating revenue was ¥75.1 billion, with operating profit of ¥3.5 billion and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥2.8 billion. The company has shown steady revenue and profit growth over the past several years, with a workforce of over 2,500 employees. The medium-term plan targets further growth, aiming for ¥82 billion in revenue and ¥4.5 billion in operating profit by 2027.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yasuda Logistics emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, high-value-added logistics solutions tailored to customer needs, supported by advanced technology, a robust domestic and international network, and a century-long track record. Its integrated approach, combining logistics and real estate expertise, enables it to offer comprehensive supply chain and facility solutions, with a strong focus on reliability, safety, and sustainability.
